title: smithable.ux.yml
description: How the app looks: the theme, icons, columns, forms and the sections' looks.

theme.description: The app's theme: a preset, the owner's colours and font, the density and the motion.

preset.description: A built-in theme (modern, minimal, playful, corporate, coastal, navy, editorial, woodland, contrast, nordic, pastel, midnight, craft, restaurant, street-food, cafe, warm-service, quiet-workspace, ink-and-brass, workbench, stillwater) or one of the project's own (themes/<name>.yml).

brand.description: The owner's own colours and font, over the preset.

background.description: A background colour, as #rrggbb: a wash of its hue in both modes.

font.description: The font: Inter, Nunito Sans, Source Sans 3, Source Serif 4, Fraunces, Archivo Narrow, DM Sans, Outfit, Hanken Grotesk, Instrument Sans, Mona Sans, Bricolage Grotesque, Oswald, Big Shoulders Display, Instrument Serif, Young Serif, Newsreader, Bodoni Moda, Zilla Slab, JetBrains Mono.

density.description: How much space the lists and forms take.

motion.description: How much moves: none, subtle (the default) or lively.

pages.description: Each page's look, by the page's name.

icon.description: The page's icon in the navigation.

table.description: A list page's table: its columns, their order, the default sort and the view.

columns.description: The fields shown as columns, in order.

totals.description: Number and amount fields summed in a last row, with the count, over every record the viewer may see that fits the filters.

below.description: A field shown under another in its column, e.g. { email: phone }: the phone number under the email.

sort.description: The field the list is sorted by, with "-" in front for the highest first, e.g. -createdAt.

view.description: On a wide screen: a table, or cards (a phone shows cards anyway).

filters.description: A list page's filters: shown, the ones shown when the list is first reached; the rest fold behind "More filters".

shown.description: The filters shown at once, from the page's filters in smithable.yml.

look.description: How the filters show: default (chips up to eight values, a list to pick from above) or chips (every choice and reference as a row of chips, with a referenced record's picture).

pick.description: How a filter on a reference is picked, by its name: list (every related record as a choice) or search (found as you type); unsaid, a search from 200 related records.

record.description: The record page: how its lists of related records are shown.

lists.description: By list field: table (the default) or thread, a conversation with a reply box, e.g. { messages: thread }.

subtitle.description: The line under a record's name on cards and in pickers: a field, a reference or a field one reference away (instructor.name).

detail.description: Smaller parts after the subtitle, e.g. [classType.level, capacity].

form.description: The page's form: the fields' order, sections, columns and controls.

fieldOrder.description: The fields in the order the form shows them.

sections.description: Groups of fields with headings: - { name: contact, fields: [email, phone] }; the heading's text is in smithable.content.yml.

name.description: The group's name; its heading is in smithable.content.yml.

columns.description: 2 puts short fields two abreast; long texts and pictures stay full width.

control.description: How a field is entered: input, slider, stepper, radio, select, combobox, textarea, switch; input is the default for its kind.

results.description: A calculator page: the results beside the inputs (the default) or below them.

frame.description: The frame the page shows in: site (the public frame with the top menu), app (the workspace with the side menu) or none (the page alone). Without it, the page kind's own.

sections.description: A landing page's sections' looks, by section name: a hero's layout, a feature list's columns.

layout.description: One of split, centered, plain, cover, photo; the first is the default.

image.description: One of right, left; the first is the default.

columns.description: One of 3, 2, 4, 5, 6; the first is the default.

band.description: The section across the width on a surface of the theme: none, muted, inverse, primary; none (the default) is an open section, or the muted band a banded theme gives every second section.

layout.description: One of cards, list, grid; the first is the default.

columns.description: One of 3, 2, 4, 5, 6, side by side on a wide screen: 3 for cards and 4 for a grid when not said; a list has none.

band.description: The section across the width on a surface of the theme: none, muted, inverse, primary; none (the default) is an open section, or the muted band a banded theme gives every second section.

layout.description: One of cards, carousel, one; the first is the default.

band.description: The section across the width on a surface of the theme: none, muted, inverse, primary; none (the default) is an open section, or the muted band a banded theme gives every second section.

highlight.description: The name of the item to set apart.

band.description: The section across the width on a surface of the theme: none, muted, inverse, primary; none (the default) is an open section, or the muted band a banded theme gives every second section.

layout.description: One of accordion, list; the first is the default.

columns.description: One of 1, 2, for the list layout; the first is the default.

header.description: A landing page's header's look: its position, sticky (kept at the top as the page scrolls, the default) or scrolling (away with the page).

position.description: One of sticky, scrolling; the first is the default.

theme.description: A landing page's own theme, over the app's: { preset: playful }, with brand, density and motion as the app's theme takes them.

preset.description: A built-in theme or one of the project's.

brand.description: The colours and font, as the app's brand.

assistant.description: Ask, the assistant in the app: its manner, as a theme is a manner (its texts are smithable.content.yml's).

voice.description: plain (the default: short, no pleasantries), friendly or formal.

navigation.description: Where the menu sits on a wide screen: sidebar (the default), topbar (a bar across the top, the name at the start) or topbar-centered (the name centred between the links).

chrome.description: The menu's surface: light (the page's own colours) or dark (the text colour as its surface); unsaid, the theme's own menu colours.

aiBadge.description: Whether pictures an AI made carry the badge ("AI-generated", "AI"): on unless you switch it off; whether your audience needs it is your responsibility.

tones.description: The meaning of a choice field's values, shown as the badge's colour: { "Order.status": { paid: success, overdue: danger } }.

additionalProperties.description: neutral, success, warning, danger; values not listed are neutral.
